title: The $q$-rious unimodality conjecture
statement:
Let $(\boldsymbol{a},\boldsymbol{b})$ be tuples of positive integers satisfying Landau's criterion, namely

$$
\sum_i\lfloor a_i x\rfloor-\sum_j\lfloor b_j x\rfloor\geqslant 0 \quad\text{for all }x\geqslant 0.
$$

Let $D(\boldsymbol{a},\boldsymbol{b};q)$ be the corresponding $q$-factorial quotient, and write its coefficients as $D(\boldsymbol{a},\boldsymbol{b};q)=\sum_{i=0}^k c_iq^i$. **$q$-rious unimodality conjecture.** The polynomial

$$
(1+q)D(\boldsymbol{a},\boldsymbol{b};q)
$$

is unimodal. This is proposed as a stronger statement implying the $q$-rious positivity conjecture, in a setting where the coefficient sequence of $D(\boldsymbol{a},\boldsymbol{b};q)$ is symmetric.
references:
Source: https://arxiv.org/abs/2502.03993

Status: no resolution is reported in the source (as of February 2025).
source_name: S. Ole Warnaar and Wadim Zudilin, “q-rious unimodality”, arXiv:2502.03993 (2025).
